display.purpose: H1–H4 headings only; never body copy. 800 weight for H1/H2, 700 for H3/H4.

body.purpose: All running copy, labels, nav, form fields.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for the sticky header, trust pills, and the primary button.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state for service cards, related cards, and buttons; resting state of the hero photo and nav dropdown.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all hover/transition states.

motion.name: hero-focal-entrance
motion.value: hero-rise 0.7s ease-out (5-step stagger incl. live badge) + hero-photo-settle 1.4s ease-out (clip-path + scale)
motion.purpose: The one authored moment on load: the homepage hero's live badge/headline/lede/actions cascade in while the full-bleed photo settles from a slight zoom behind the gradient overlay.

motion.name: live-badge-pulse
motion.value: live-ping 1.8s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite on the dot's ::before, only when open
motion.purpose: Signals the live open/closed badge is a real-time computed state, not static chrome. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: stagger-list
motion.value: keyframe stagger-rise 0.55s ease-out, +0.06s per sibling, capped at 10 children
motion.purpose: Supporting motion for lists (service cards, gallery, related cards, partner logos) via `animation`, never `transition`.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action across the site (Demander un devis, Envoyer ma demande). Dark-ink resting state; terracotta inside the hero specifically, so the single most important action stays the accent color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1b2a30; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,42,48,0.06), 0 14px 32px -18px rgba(27,42,48,0.22); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #437880; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(27,42,48,0.1), 0 22px 44px -20px rgba(27,42,48,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4883a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action (Toutes les prestations, Voir toute la galerie). Hover fills teal, never terracotta.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1b2a30; border: 1.5px solid #c7d1d4; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #5a9ea6; background: #e8f4f6; color: #437880; }

components.name: Phone Pill
components.description: The always-visible emergency phone affordance in the header, hero, and CTA banners.
components.css: .ds-phone-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #d4883a; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.6rem 1.05rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); text-decoration: none; } .ds-phone-pill:hover { background: #b8702c; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Icon-badge card used identically on the homepage and prestations.html to list all seven trades, replacing the previous photo-led Service Row and homepage bento grid. The urgent trade uses the dark `--urgent` variant instead of a separate banner.
components.html:
Travaux de couverture

Réfection, rénovation et création de toitures, tuiles comme ardoises.

Découvrir
components.css: .ds-service-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e3e8ea; border-radius: 1.25rem; padding: 2rem 1.5rem; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(27,42,48,0.1), 0 22px 44px -20px rgba(27,42,48,0.3); border-color: transparent; } .ds-service-card__icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 3.1rem; height: 3.1rem; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: #e8f4f6; color: #437880; } .ds-service-card__go { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: #d4883a; margin-top: auto; } .ds-service-card--urgent { background: #1b2a30; border-color: #1b2a30; } .ds-service-card--urgent h3 { color: #ffffff; } .ds-service-card--urgent .ds-service-card__icon { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: #e5a75e; }

components.name: Live Status Badge
components.description: Homepage-hero-only pill badge computed client-side from the business's real declared hours (Lun-Sam 8h-18h); never a decorative or hardcoded 'online now' prop.
components.css: .ds-live-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.28); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-live-badge__dot { position: relative; width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #6bc78a; } .ds-live-badge__dot::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -4px; border-radius: 999px; background: #6bc78a; opacity: 0.45; animation: live-ping 1.8s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite; } .ds-live-badge.is-closed .ds-live-badge__dot, .ds-live-badge.is-closed .ds-live-badge__dot::before { background: #b9c3c6; }

components.name: Related Card
components.description: Small photo card linking to a related service, used at the bottom of every service detail page.
components.html:
Travaux de zinguerie

Solins & raccords →
components.css: .ds-related-card { display: block; border-radius: 0.9rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e8ea; background: #ffffff; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } .ds-related-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(27,42,48,0.1), 0 22px 44px -20px rgba(27,42,48,0.3); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-related-card__media { aspect-ratio: 16/10; overflow: hidden; } .ds-related-card__body { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; } .ds-related-card__body h4 { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; } .ds-related-card__body span { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #d4883a; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form input/textarea/select used throughout the contact form. Focus ring is teal (calm state), never terracotta.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #45565c; } .ds-field input { border: 1px solid #c7d1d4; border-radius: 0.3rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; background: #ffffff; color: #1b2a30; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #5a9ea6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e8f4f6; outline: none; }

narrative.northStar: The Professional Roofer's Site (user-pinned reference: dt-couverture-33.fr)
narrative.overview: Alpha Bâtiment is a multi-trade roofing, zinc-work, insulation and facade contractor in rural Dordogne. This second design pass supersedes the first, stone-neutral 'Architect's Site Visit' system (preserved on branch design-v1-canon-artisan): the client pinned a concrete competitor reference and asked the site to follow its visual world — a confident, modern trade-site register with a teal/terracotta palette, rounded icon-badge service cards, pill badges, and a full-bleed photo hero with a dark gradient overlay. The reference's palette, type pairing, radius scale, shadow language, and card/badge vocabulary are adopted; nothing the reference cannot prove for Alpha Bâtiment is — no fabricated review score, no invented experience statistic, no decorative 'online now' indicator. The one live-status badge is computed client-side from the business's real declared hours.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white paper ground, dark-navy ink — a calmer, cooler register than the previous stone-neutral system.
Two-color brand duo: teal (structure, calm, links, focus) and terracotta (action, urgency, every clickable CTA).
Montserrat (700/800) display paired with Open Sans body.
Generously rounded corners everywhere (radius-lg/xl, pill badges) — the previous tight 3-6px radius is gone.
Custom line icons (not a generic icon font) carry the seven-trade service grid.

rules.name: The Two-Color Rule
rules.body: Teal is calm and structural (it never asks for a click); terracotta is the only color that means 'act here' (buttons, phone numbers, hover underlines, urgent states). A non-interactive heading or text block turning terracotta is a bug.

rules.name: The Truthful-Badge Rule
rules.body: Every badge, stat, and status indicator is computed from a real fact (the live-status badge from real hours, gallery tags from the real trade shown) — never a static prop borrowed from the reference site.

dos: Do keep terracotta reserved for things the visitor can act on.
Do keep every badge/stat/status computed from a real fact, never borrowed from the reference.
Do draw service-card icons in the site's own 24x24 line-icon grammar rather than an icon font.
Do use real, unstaged job-site photography for the hero and gallery.
Do keep the phone number visible in the header and every CTA banner.
donts: Don't show a review score, star rating, or testimonial — none are verified.
Don't invent a years-in-business or project-count statistic.
Don't let the live-status badge become decorative or drift from the real footer hours.
Don't mix teal and terracotta on the same interactive element as interchangeable accents.
Don't use pure black anywhere; the darkest surface is #1b2a30, always navy-warm.
